scripts.predev: npx kill-port 5173 8000 || echo ports were already free
scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n frontend,backend -c cyan,green "npm --prefix frontend run dev" ".venv\Scripts\python.exe -m uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000 --app-dir backend"
scripts.prestart: npx kill-port 5173 8000 || echo ports were already free
scripts.start: concurrently -n airflow,trigger,backend,frontend -c magenta,yellow,green,cyan "cd backend && docker compose up" "node scripts/trigger-genre-pipeline.js" ".venv\Scripts\python.exe -m uvicorn app.main:app --port 8000 --app-dir backend" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.preoffline: npx kill-port 5173 8000 || echo ports were already free
scripts.offline: node scripts/prepare-offline.js && concurrently -n backend,frontend -c green,cyan ".venv\Scripts\python.exe -m uvicorn app.main:app --port 8000 --app-dir backend" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
